messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm the first time R-SWAT user, I like how straightforward and clear it is. However, I met this observation data error and the Shiny just crashed when I tried to run multi-site calibration (see the attached figure `Capture.JPG). I couldn't figure out what's wrong. Can anyone help? Thank you!

I set the date range between 1995-01-01 to 2023-12-31, and I have my observation data with the same length, but I flagged "C" for only 1995-01-01 to 2015-12-31. I attached my RSWATproject and observation data below.

Best regards,
Yufen
